title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Trust Account Errors - Minor Amounts
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: During a monthly trust account reconciliation, a paralegal discovers a mathematical error resulted in a $10 shortage in the trust account. Does the paralegal really need to replace such a minor amount?
options: No, shortages under $50 are considered immaterial by the LSO.
Yes, any shortage, no matter how small, must be eliminated immediately by depositing general funds into the trust account.
No, the paralegal can just subtract $10 from the next client's bill.
Yes, but they have until the end of the fiscal year to correct it.
questions.explain: By-Law 9 dictates that a licensee who discovers a trust shortage, regardless of the amount (even a few dollars or cents), must immediately pay sufficient funds into the account from their general funds to resolve the deficit.
